fusions.name: Hurled Lance
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 35 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at maximum range, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Doorward Thrust
fusions.desc: Thrusts for 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Aimed Reply
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
